do_not_change.summary: Keep the adapter read-only and limited to the current previous-complete-month service read.
do_not_change.evidence: ADR-019 requires read tools before write tools, while ADR-035 defers build, publication, history, sharing, and scheduling to separate boundaries.
do_not_change.impact: Adding build, publication, arbitrary-period, provider, or share behavior would exceed the approved authority boundary.
do_not_change.recommendation: Preserve the single authorized getGrowthMonthlyReport(projectId) delegation and server-side SAM project binding.

do_not_change.summary: Preserve the strict monthly DTO as the structured output boundary.
do_not_change.evidence: The DTO strictly allowlists lifecycle/report content and excludes stored-report IDs, actors, sources, evidence, hashes, and internal versions.
do_not_change.impact: Replacing it with persisted report objects or loose output would expose internal Growth data to MCP and SAM consumers.
do_not_change.recommendation: Return it only as structuredContent.summary and validate the wrapper with the declared output schema.
